- Spencer asked why Tavis's September sales show $10,500 in Jobber's Salesperson Performance report but he was paid on $8,040, and wanted the gap explained.
- The assistant pulled the converted-quote data and reconciled the two figures. Jobber counts quotes by draft date (9 quotes, $10,500). The payout used approval date (7 quotes, $8,040, earning $600 at $75 per $1,000 × 8).
- Two September-drafted quotes, #14174 Point Nautica ($1,380, approved 10-07) and #14191 Liz Silke ($1,080, approved 10-13), were approved in October, so they fall into October's band (3 sales, $3,660, $150 so far).
- Under a draft-date basis, September would have been $750 (10 × $75) and October would have one sale and no bonus. Either way, each sale is credited once; the basis only determines which month's band it lands in.
- The Jobber report also lists 23 quotes ($26,820) still awaiting response and 5 archived. These are excluded from the $10,500 because it counts converted quotes only, and would count in the month they are approved if they convert.
